components.name: Cedar post/wall bay
components.function: Need long wall/post bay, gable/roof ridge end, porch threshold and carved curved ridge supports. Source already contains cedar grain, amber glazing and Nordic scrolls; do not reuse B12 crown signs or Gothic capitals indiscriminately. Conifers/heather/moss; fox/hare/woodland birds proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated cedar post/wall bay matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
